previous_statement: For X=U, let iota_U:B_U -> q_U B_R q_U be the canonical coordinate map iota_U(b_U)=(b_U,0), a linear bijection with inverse (b_U,0) |-> b_U. The diagonal level-one map produced in the explicit datum of 1.2 is the outer-compressed map T_U=Co^{A_R}_{P_U^R} o Co^A_{P_R} o v_U from lem-maincb-outer-compression-transfer. That external result, applied to the outer-compression instance certified by the construction in lem-maincb-cross-class-merging-datum, makes T_U an extended isomorphism and hence a bijection by def-extended-delta-inclusion. The displayed definition gives gamma_UU o iota_U=T_U, so gamma_UU is bijective and is exactly the fixed U,U map of the datum.
new_statement: The fixed U,U level-one map in the datum of 1.2 is the displayed gamma_UU, and gamma_UU is bijective.
